literature_notes: L1 (HiBiT, C-terminus, PMC7940577): The tag is at the intracellular C-terminus (residue 290, topology INTRACELLULAR per landmarks); it is a valid published insertion but faces the cytoplasm, so it is recorded in other_positions only. L2 (HA-ins-PD-L1, PMC13039446): The clip names the tagged construct but specifies no residue number and no loop for the HA insertion site; the ICD deletion (260–290) is a separate construct, not the insertion site; without a pinnable position this clip cannot ground a site. L3 (EGFP at start codon, mouse Cd274, PMC10085585): Insertion at the start codon places EGFP upstream of the signal peptide (residues 1–18 in human CD274); a tag upstream of the signal peptide is co-translationally cleaved and is not displayed on the extracellular surface; the construct is used to identify PD-L1-expressing cells by fluorescence, consistent with cytoplasmic EGFP, not a surface label. No ledger line supports an extracellular surface tag site for CD274.

literature_other_positions.note: HiBiT tag knocked in at the C-terminus of endogenous CD274 in PC9 cells; residue 290 (T) is the last intracellular residue per topology landmarks — tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
